title: hypericum acutum subsp. undulatum
intro: Hypericum acutum subsp. undulatum, commonly known as a type of St. John's Wort, is a plant species that belongs to the Hypericaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with health benefits including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum acutum subsp. undulatum include its ability to reduce pain, anxiety, and stress, as well as its potential to treat wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and hyperforin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
